title: Pure Hunder
summary: The Hunder family—Pahunder, Mahunder, Sishunder, and Brohunder—is an explosive LIGHT Thunder chain-Normal Summon archetype. Because Pahunder and Mahunder grant additional Normal Summons via activated ignition effects, summoning one chains into the next, rapidly swarming 3 to 4 Level 4 monsters in a single turn without relying on Special Summons. This effortlessly unlocks powerful Rank 4 bosses like Starliege Paladynamo and the board-wiping Number 91: Thunder Spark Dragon, or Level 8 Synchro plays with Tuner Vylon Prism, all refueled each turn by Recycling Batteries.

allow.Batteryman Solar: Level 4 LIGHT Thunder that dumps a Thunder monster on Summon and generates a Token when another Thunder is summoned.
allow.Vylon Prism: Level 4 LIGHT Thunder Tuner that is searchable by Brohunder and Thunder Sea Horse, tunes into a Level 8 Synchro, and equips itself from GY for +1000 ATK.
allow.Recycling Batteries: Spell that adds 2 Thunder monsters with 1500 or less ATK (Pahunder, Mahunder, Brohunder, Sishunder, Vylon Prism, or Batteryman Solar!) from your GY back to your hand.
allow.Starliege Paladynamo: Rank 4 LIGHT Xyz that detaches 2 materials to reduce an opponent's monster's ATK to 0 and negate its effects, and draws 1 card when destroyed.
allow.Bujintei Tsukuyomi: Rank 4 LIGHT Xyz that detaches 1 material to discard your remaining hand and draw 2 fresh cards after emptying your hand with Pahunder and Mahunder.
allow.Number 91: Thunder Spark Dragon: Signature Rank 4 LIGHT Dragon Xyz that detaches 3 materials to destroy all other face-up monsters on the field, or 5 materials to destroy all cards the opponent controls.
allow.Crimson Blader: Level 8 Synchro made with Pahunder/Mahunder + Level 4 LIGHT Thunder Tuner Vylon Prism that locks the opponent out of Level 5+ summons.
allow.Scarlight Red Dragon Archfiend: Level 8 DARK Dragon Synchro that destroys all Special Summoned monsters on the field with ATK less than or equal to its own and burns for each.
allow.Some Summer Summoner: Link-2 LIGHT Thunder that discards 1 card during the opponent's turn to revive Pahunder, Mahunder, or Batteryman Solar from the GY.

main: Core Level 4 LIGHT Thunder (1300 ATK): once per turn, activates an Ignition Effect to immediately Normal Summon 1 Level 4 LIGHT Thunder monster from your hand (except Pahunder) as an additional Normal Summon.

Core Level 4 LIGHT Thunder (1400 ATK): once per turn, activates an Ignition Effect to immediately Normal Summon 1 Level 4 LIGHT Thunder monster from your hand (except Mahunder) as an additional Normal Summon—chaining directly off Pahunder!

Level 4 LIGHT Thunder (900 ATK): when Normal Summoned, adds ANY Level 4 LIGHT Thunder monster with 1600 or less ATK (Pahunder, Mahunder, Sishunder, Thunder Sea Horse, or Vylon Prism!) from your Deck to your hand.
Level 4 LIGHT Thunder (900 ATK): when Normal Summoned, banishes 1 Level 4 LIGHT Thunder monster with 1600 or less ATK from your GY and adds it to your hand during the End Phase.
Discards itself from the hand to add 2 Level 4 LIGHT Thunder monsters with 1600 or less ATK and the same name from your Deck to your hand.

Level 4 LIGHT Thunder Tuner (1500 ATK): searchable by Brohunder and Thunder Sea Horse, and Normal Summonable via Pahunder/Mahunder! Tunes into a Level 8 Synchro and equips itself from the GY for +1000 ATK!
Level 4 LIGHT Thunder (1500 ATK): searchable by Brohunder and Normal Summonable via Pahunder/Mahunder; dumps a Thunder from Deck to GY and summons a Token.
Adds any 2 Thunder monsters with 1500 or less ATK from your GY back to your hand.
Continuous Spell: attaches 1 Level 4 LIGHT monster you control to an Xyz Monster, and recovers 2 Level 4 LIGHT Thunder monsters from your GY when sent to the GY.
extra: Rank 4 LIGHT Xyz: detaches 2 materials to permanently set an opponent's monster's ATK to 0 and negate its effects, and draws 1 card if destroyed by the opponent.
Rank 4 LIGHT Xyz: detaches 3 materials to destroy all other face-up monsters on the field, or 5 materials to wipe the opponent's entire board!
Rank 4 LIGHT Xyz: detaches 1 material after you Normal Summon your entire hand via Pahunder/Mahunder to draw 2 new cards!
Level 8 Synchro made with Pahunder/Mahunder + Vylon Prism that locks the opponent out of Level 5+ summons.
Level 8 Synchro that destroys Special Summoned monsters and burns.
Link-2 LIGHT Thunder that revives a Thunder monster from GY during the opponent's turn.
